items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I didn't meet Linton until we were doing the big show with Nat and Duke, Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: Never eight bars. But I also during that time I saw Blanton, Jimmy Blanton. He was in Pittsburgh. He was working one of the showboats, what do you call up and down the river, you know. He was working on this boat with a man by the name of Fate Marble. They were coming from St. Louis. But I had met Blanton before, in St. Louis, when I was with Roy. But he was then in Pittsburgh at this time. This is just before he went with Duke. But he was also -- he was a monster, you know. Those were good days, you know, very…
